context: Request: most recent M&A deal with a working-capital adjustment, by executed APA signing date, as a template for a new SPA. Rubric: 1006-00008 (Crestline / Lakewood, executed APA 16 June 2025), its asset-purchase-agreement-execution.docx, and a precision criterion (no other matter asserted as qualifying).

runs.failure_point: It named the right deal and agreement, but its comparator section asserts several other matters' agreements as executed deals with the same adjustment.

first_error.why: The comparator section presents other matters' agreements, read only at their openings ([32]-[40]) or seen in scan snippets, as executed deals with a working-capital adjustment, so the answer asserts them as qualifying.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) the check review at [102] flagged late-added comparators that may not qualify; the agent finished without checking them.

divergence: All three runs failed. T0 overflowed the context with its first store-wide extraction script (4.9M characters) before any review or read. T1 and T2 both found and read the qualifying matter's executed agreement and named it, but failed the same way at Write the response: their date comparison presented other matters' agreements, read only at their openings, as executed deals with the same adjustment. T1's write review did not flag this; T2's check review flagged possibly non-qualifying comparators and the agent finished unchanged.
